name: pending-questions
description: An agent inbox side pane: the questions the agent asks you, its task list and the actions only you can do, kept until you deal with them.

sound.title: Sound on new items
sound.description: What plays when the agent registers a new question or action, or the task list changes, on macOS: alert, the macOS alert sound; ding, a short built-in tone; off, nothing.

tasksFile.title: Tasks file
tasksFile.description: The file the agent keeps its task list in, relative to the project root, absolute or starting with ~. Empty means TASKS.md at the project root. A path picked in the pane for a project wins over this.
